enchantments.tooltip: +14 Enhancement Bonus: +14 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Deadly +10: +10 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Quality Stunning +3: +3 Quality bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Shocking: Deals 12d6 Electric damage on hits.
Shocking Burst: Deals Burst Electric damage on critical hits, increasing with higher critical multipliers on the weapon.
Shocking Blast: Deals 12d120 Electric damage on vorpal hits.
Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one die.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
